response.overview: Mindy (Korra Del Rio) and Chris (Joel Someone) arrive at Chris' home from a successful first meetup. It's clear from their flirty demeanor that they are both hoping for something more to end the night with as they step inside. As Mindy marvels over how well-kept the house is, Chris reveals that he's married... A barista, Jessica (Jenna Creed), is working when two new customers enter the cafe. She instantly brightens up as she recognizes them as her old friend, Alex, and his parent, Robert (Chris Epic). However, they are confused and can't figure out who she is. Jessica reveals that she used to know them while presenting as a boy named Timothy. She moved out of their neighborhood a few years ago and started transitioning to live her life as her true self. While Robert is happy to see her, Alex doesn't take the revelation well...
response.title: I'm Not Some Fetish
